definitions.gloss: to pin down; to wrestle to the ground; to overpower
definitions.explanation: To grapple with someone and force them face-down onto the ground, holding them in place. Often used for police subduing suspects or in martial arts contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せた。
⟦{警察官|けいさつかん}→警察官：05056_keisatsukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暴|あば}れる→暴れる：04575_abareru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せて⟦{逮捕|たいほ}した→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧。
examples.english: The police officer pinned down the violent man and arrested him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{通行人|つうこうにん}→通行人：28570_tsuukounin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧⟦{逃|に}げよう→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧とした⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せ、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{押|お}さえていた→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: Passersby cooperated to pin down the fleeing suspect and held him until the police arrived.

notes:
{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる is a transitive ichidan verb. It is a compound of ⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧ (to grapple, to wrestle) and ⟦{伏|ふ}せる→伏せる：11515_fuseru⟧ (to lay face-down).

ASPECT (ている):
{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates the resulting state of having someone pinned down.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [person]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる (to pin someone down)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる (to pin down a criminal)
- ⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる (to wrestle to the ground)
- ⟦{取|と}り{押|お}さえて→取り押さえる：28563_toriosaeru⟧{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる (to seize and pin down)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる: to pin down physically by wrestling
- ⟦{取|と}り{押|お}さえる→取り押さえる：28563_toriosaeru⟧: to apprehend, to restrain (more general)
- {押|お}さえつける: to hold down, to press down
